help.db: No bundled database. QwenPaw Hub runs as one control-plane container from the official agentscope/qwenpaw image and provisions one isolated QwenPaw runtime per user with the Local backend; the control database and every user workspace persist under /app/working in the qwenpaw_data volume. The first administrator is seeded from W9_LOGIN_USER / W9_LOGIN_PASSWORD on first startup. Set QWENPAW_HUB_REGISTRATION_MODE to open, invite, or closed to control self-registration.
